yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No month/day is spoken in session 110. The May 20–21 calendar is conditional on YAML; the transcript independently establishes a morning opening and one completed 5 p.m.–1 a.m. overnight.
yamlCheck.explanation: The continuous adventure covers one civil midnight, followed by the defense, lair exploration, treasure sorting and return sailing. Historical jade visions do not extend the adventure span. The 2/3 a.m. disagreement is within the same civil day and does not change this relative date-span match. Sailing back to Vindristjarna has no stated duration or arrival watch; the source supplies no additional overnight. Absolute dates are not independently verified by this relative match.
